title: put_donut
description: Event: a donut was put with its TTLs.

requestedTtl.description: seconds this package asked the store to keep the entry. 0 or null means it asked for no expiry - the entry is meant to live until event-driven invalidation, but a backend may impose its own floor (symfony/cache RedisTagAwareAdapter gives an unexpiring tagged entry 8640000s, since Redis cannot expire tag sets). 31536000 is the `never` convention (365 days). What the store actually did is a property of the deployment: read it there (`TTL <key>` on Redis)

sMaxAge.description: CDN s-maxage in seconds (putStatic only: also used as the rendered view's TTL; putDonut and interceptor-driven puts log null)
